title: ITC Q2 FY27 Results: Taxation Impact and Share Outlook
description: ITC has scheduled its board meeting to announce Q2 FY27 financial results. Analysts anticipate a potential decline in net profit for the quarter, primarily du.

faq.q: Why do cigarette taxes impact ITC's net profit so much?
faq.a: ITC is India's largest cigarette manufacturer, and this segment contributes a significant portion of its revenue and operating profit. Any increase in excise duties or other taxes directly affects its pricing power, sales volumes, and ultimately, its profit margins.

faq.q: What are ITC's other major business segments?
faq.a: Beyond cigarettes, ITC has a diversified portfolio including Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) like Aashirvaad and Sunfeast, Hotels, Agri-Business (e.g., commodity exports), and Paperboards, Paper & Packaging.

faq.q: How do diversified businesses help a company like ITC?
faq.a: Diversification helps reduce reliance on a single business segment. If one segment faces challenges (like increased taxation for cigarettes), strong performance in other segments can help cushion the overall financial impact and provide more stable growth.

faq.q: Where can I find the official Q2 FY27 results once declared?
faq.a: The official results will be available on the stock exchange websites (BSE India and NSE India) where ITC is listed, and typically on ITC's investor relations section of its corporate website.

faq.q: Should I sell my ITC shares if profits decline due to taxation?
faq.a: A short-term decline in profit due to specific regulatory changes doesn't automatically warrant selling. Long-term investors should evaluate the company's overall strategy, growth in other segments, dividend policy, and future outlook before making any investment decisions.
